bullets.text: Strategic Market Status Granted - **Apple** and **Google** face new regulations as UK designates them with strategic market status.
AI Lens Launch - **Snapchat** introduces its first open prompt AI Lens for all users, enhancing creative possibilities.
Apple Watch Innovations - New **Apple Watch** features include hypertension alerts, expanding health monitoring capabilities.
Tesla's Revenue Rebound - **Tesla** reports a profitable quarter as consumers rush to claim expiring EV tax credits.
Portable Cinema Projector - **Aurzen** BOOM Air projector impresses with quality and affordability, transforming viewing experiences.
Robot Lawn Mower Review - **Ecovacs** Goat A3000 offers smart lawn care solutions, though not without limitations.
Apple Vision Pro Update - The new **Apple Vision Pro** features an improved band design for enhanced comfort.
Anker's New Chargers - **Anker** launches compact Nano chargers for **iPhone 17**, enhancing convenience for users.
